name: B10-0228/2024 (PPE) – Human rights situation in Kyrgyzstan, in particular the case of Temirlan Sultanbekov
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the human rights situation in Kyrgyzstan, in particular the case of Temirlan Sultanbekov
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking Kyrgyzstan to respect human rights and democratic freedoms. It calls for the release of politicians, journalists and activists held in detention, including Temirlan Sultanbekov and four journalists from Temirov Live and Ait Ait Dese. It urges Kyrgyzstan to stop intimidating opposition parties and independent media, to let Kloop Media operate again, and to bring its laws on free speech and political rights in line with international standards. The Parliament is stating its position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament asks Kyrgyzstan to free detained politicians, journalists and activists and drop their charges.
- It affects opposition parties, independent media and journalists in Kyrgyzstan.
- Next, the resolution is sent to European Union bodies and the Kyrgyz authorities; no law changes.
